article.story: BINGHAMTON, N.Y. -- — Demetrius Lilley scored 16 points as Binghamton beat Army 67-46 on Saturday. Lilley added 20 rebounds for the Bearcats (4-3). Dylan Godfrey scored 11 points and added eight rebounds. Jeremiah Quigley shot 3 of 9 from the field and 5 for 5 from the line to finish with 11 points. Dillon Watt led the Black Knights (2-4) in scoring, finishing with 13 points. Kevin McCarthy added seven points for Army. Ryan Curry finished with four points and six rebounds. Binghamton took the lead for good with 18:15 remaining in the first half. The score was 35-18 at halftime, with Lilley racking up seven points. Binghamton extended its lead to 45-18 during the second half, fueled by a 10-0 scoring run. Lilley scored a team-high nine points in the second half as their team closed out the win. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
